WITH p AS (
  SELECT P.ID, P.SEX,
         AVG(L.ALB) - AVG(L.TP) AS alb_tp,
         AVG(CASE WHEN L.APTT IS NOT NULL AND L.PT IS NOT NULL THEN L.APTT - L.PT END) AS ap_pt
  FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID
  GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX
),
s AS (
  SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_tp) AS alb_tp, AVG(ap_pt) AS ap_pt
  FROM p GROUP BY SEX
),
m AS (SELECT AVG(ap_pt) AS mean_ap FROM s)
SELECT AVG(s.alb_tp) AS avg_alb_tp,
       AVG(s.ap_pt) AS avg_aptt_pt,
       AVG(s.ap_pt) - (SELECT mean_ap FROM m) AS excess_over_mean
FROM s
WHERE s.ap_pt > (SELECT mean_ap FROM m)
